description: This file defines an AuthService class that encapsulates authentication-related API calls such as registration, login, fetching user info, and updating password, utilizing an external ApiService.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class providing methods for user registration, login, fetching user profile, and updating password, interfacing with backend API.

methods.name: updateToken
methods.description: Updates the authentication token used by the API service.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, returning a UserPublic object.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates the user with email and password, returning a Token object.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile information.
